newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: John Govett Asia launches new unit trust.
newsitem.headline: John Govett Asia launches new unit trust.

text.p: John Govett Asia Ltd said on Monday it was launching a new unit trust, the Govett Global Brands Fund.
John Govett, part of Allied Irish Banks plc, is targetting the fund at Singapore investors, said Mark Browning, director of investment marketing at a press briefing.
He said the fund, which would pick on listed companies that own product brands recognised globally, would give Singapore investors an opportunity to invest outside of Asia.
The fund would pick about 35 to 40 stocks, most of which would be located in the United States, the United Kingdom and Europe with a few in Japan and South Korea.
John Govett has another unit trust, the Govett Asia Pacific Growth Fund, launched in 1995.
Regional managing director Tan Jee Say said the company has plans to launch another fund this year but declined to give details.
